item.title: Apple updates MacBook Air with M5
item.description: Apple Inc. has introduced a new MacBook Air powered by its latest in-house processor, the M5 chip, continuing the company’s steady annual cadence of silicon upgrades. The refresh brings Apple’s newest system-on-chip architecture to its mainstream laptop line in 13-inch and 15-inch configurations. Base storage now starts at 512 GB, configurable up to 4 TB […] This story continues at The Next Web

item.title: Antiverse raises $9.3M Series A to scale AI-driven antibody discovery from Cardiff
item.description: Cardiff-based Antiverse, a biotechnology company developing AI-powered therapeutic antibody discovery tools, has closed a $9.3 million Series A financing to expand its computational platform and advance lead programmes toward in vivo studies. The round was led by Soulmates Ventures with participation from Innovation Investment Capital, DOMiNO Ventures, and existing backers including DBW, Kadmos Capital and […] This story continues at The Next Web

item.title: Oxa secures $103M Series D first close to scale autonomous vehicles for industrial logistics
item.description: Oxford-based autonomous vehicle software company Oxa has raised $103 million in the first close of its Series D round to expand deployment of its industrial self-driving platform. The round includes a $50 million commitment from the UK National Wealth Fund, alongside investments from NVentures (NVIDIA’s venture arm), IP Group, Hostplus, and bp Ventures. item.title: PLD Space raises €180M Series C to scale Europe’s commercial launch capabilities
item.description: Spanish launch company PLD Space, headquartered in Elche, has secured €180 million in Series C funding to accelerate production of its orbital rocket systems and expand global launch operations. The round includes strategic participation from Mitsubishi Electric alongside public and private investors such as CDTI Innvierte, COFIDES, and Nazca Capital. item.title: GHARAGE Ventures launches €40M Fund I to back travel and airport technology startups
item.description: Berlin- and Singapore-based venture platform GHARAGE Ventures has launched Fund I, a €40 million early-stage fund focused on technologies shaping the future of travel infrastructure and airport retail. item.title: Photoncycle raises €15M Series A to address Europe’s seasonal energy storage gap
item.description: Norwegian energy storage startup Photoncycle has raised €15 million in Series A funding to commercialise its seasonal energy storage technology across Europe. item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3 Instant to improve ChatGPT’s most-used model
item.description: OpenAI has released GPT-5.3 Instant, the latest iteration of the fast, general-purpose model that powers everyday interactions in ChatGPT. Rather than introducing a new frontier model, the update focuses on refining the system that handles most routine queries: improving response quality, conversational flow, and reliability across common tasks. item.title: Mutable Tactics raises €1.8 million in a pre-seed fund to develop drone automation with AI
item.description: Mutable Tactics, a UK-based defense-tech startup, just raised €1.8 million in a pre-seed fund round to develop an AI software that enables drone team collaboration for autonomous operation and decision-making when communications are lost or unreliable. item.title: The Designer rebuilding AI interfaces for humans
item.description: Valentyn Pavliuchenko, head of Hosanna Studio, suggests replacing inhumane AI prompting with intuitive, high-performance interfaces that bridge the gap between technical power and human desirability While AI and WebGL provide immense power, they often fail through cold, mechanical interfaces that alienate users. item.title: Accenture agrees $1.2B deal to acquire Ookla (Speedtest and Downdetector) from Ziff Davis
item.description: Global consulting and technology services firm Accenture has agreed to acquire Ookla, the Seattle-based network intelligence company best known for Speedtest and Downdetector, in a deal valued at $1.2 billion in cash.
